half: realism (the 1.4M-frame memory-stress half is NOT covered here)
source: real capture (Nitroba University Harassment scenario, digitalcorpora), Ethernet
description: 94,410 real Ethernet frames over 4h22m: TCP/HTTP/TLS, UDP DNS/SSDP/SIP/NTP, ARP, ICMP. Mixed real-world noise for false-positive calibration and throughput measurement.

captureQuality.notes: No frame has cap_len < len, so despite the 4096 snaplen the engine must NOT raise capture.truncated.

mustReport.evidenceFrames: engine output must be within +/-5% of 3147 frames
mustReport.detail: 3.33% of TCP frames are retransmissions across 2,027 conversations

mustReport.evidenceFrames: engine output must be within +/-5% of 1522 frames
mustReport.detail: 1,522 duplicate ACKs, concentrated in the large HTTP downloads

mustReport.evidenceFrames: engine output must be within +/-2% of 391 frames
mustReport.detail: 391 RST frames - normal browser teardown behaviour at this scale, must be summarized per-flow and not emitted as 391 separate findings

mustReport.evidenceFrames: engine output must be within +/-2% of 489 responses

aggregationContract.rule: Every finding class must roll up to one finding per rule per flow (or per rule overall with a count), never one finding per frame. A run that emits thousands of findings fails the fixture even if every individual detection is correct.
aggregationContract.zeroWindow: The single zero-window frame must be surfaced as at most 'info' - one event in 83,114 TCP frames is not a stall.

performanceContract.purpose: throughput and stability only, NOT the memory-stress gate
performanceContract.note: 56 MB / 94,410 frames at 579 B average. Item 24's 1.4M-frame small-packet memory stress must come from a separately generated synthetic replay - this file does not satisfy it.

notes: Primary false-positive calibration fixture. Reference ground truth is reference/real/nitroba.tshark.csv.gz (gzipped per-frame CSV) and reference/real/nitroba.phs.txt (protocol hierarchy). The capture itself is intentionally not committed - verify md5 9981827f11968773ff815e39f5458ec8 before use.
